༄༅/ /khong lhog nag po'i srung ba rtog med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// khong lhog nag po'i srung ba rtog med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs//

dri med pad sdong las 'khrungs sprul pa'i sku /o rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// rnam kun dad pas phyi nang gsang bas mchod// sgo gsum gus pas snying nas phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir nad ngan khong lhog dar// mi rnams myur gsod gso byed sman pa yang*// rang srung med na rang srog thed la 'bor// de phyir bslu ba med pa'i go cha yis// bsrung ba'i man ngag gud du sbas pa yang*// brtse ba'i sems kyis 'di na gsal bar bstan// snying 'dra'i slob bu dam ldan ma gtogs pa// kun la spel na bka' gsang 'chol bar 'gyur// de phyir slar yang 'di ni dam du sba// rtog med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bri rdzas ni// btsan dug gu gul shu dag shing kun dang*// ldong ros gi wang gla rtsi ba bla dang*// rgya snag sbyar bas shog bu gtsang ma la// phag nag lto bar mu khyud gsum bskor ba'i// dang po lte ba'i dbus su khroṃ gcig bri// klad kor steng nas g.yas skor sngags 'di bkod// oṃ phe khyi ma ni swā hā/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /gnyis pa rtsibs lnga'i steng nas rim pa bzhin/ oṃ oṃ de ba nan/ ka ru na da te sad/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /oṃ oṃ bram ze sad shog sad/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /oṃ oṃ zhu ze zhu ze zhu sad/ shog se shog sad/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /oṃ oṃ gnam lcags rdo rje kha ya bram/ gnam lcags rdo rje du ya bram/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /oṃ oṃ gnam lcags rdo rje thib sod/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /rtsibs mchan lnga'i drug stod nas brtsam ste/ oṃ ga ru ḍaḥtsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /tad+ya thā/ yi kha si ba su a gi swā hā/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /tad+ya thā ma hā gha ma li hi hi/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig

/tad+ya thā bdag la a gi badz+ra ra ga na dwa hi kañcar/ ra med pa'ang 'dug / du ra ma hi/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /tad+ya thā/ kan dhi hi kañca du ru mi/ oṃ ga gi ni ra/ 'chang ba la rims nad thams cad srungs shig /de'i phyi rim mu khyud 'khor ma la/ khroṃ gyi klad kor steng du oṃ bzhag nas/ ye dharmā brgyad shad cig dag par bri// yi ge ma chad ma lhag ma sub cing*// ma zhar gsal ba 'khor lo'i dam tshig yin// gzhan yang de 'dra'i 'khor lo lugs zlog kyang*// dpe chung ltar bris stegs khar me tog gi /gdan la legs bkram rab tu gnas pa ni/ bdag dang srung ba phag nag 'jigs su rung*// spu rtse kham nag me dpung 'bar ba yi// lto bar 'khor lo yig 'bru bkra bar bsgom// snying gar lus phyed thon pa'i phag dkar yang*// ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bsam nas ni// 'khor lo'i sngags rnams thams cad nyer gcig re// rten 'brel snying po dag kyang nyer gcig bzlas// me tog gtor zhing dkon mchog gsum gyi ni// bkra shis tshig brjod 'khor lo kha sbyar bas// mgo mjug bsnol lteb tshon skud sna lngas bcings// slar yang ye dhar bzlas shing me tog dor// bsrung bya'i mgul btags 'di yi dam tshig tu// mi lag mi 'grim slob dpon rang gis gdags// che ba brjod cing yid ches nges pa bskyed// yon med srung ba bshos med lha bshos 'dra// de phyir slob dpon yon la mi blta yang*// srung yon bzang po rgyab chos rim gro yin// yid ches med na rke la rdo bcangs 'dra// de phyir nges pa rnyed cing mos pa bya// 'di ni u rgyan thugs kyi bcud phyung ba// zhal gdams dang bcas lhag ma med par bstan// snyigs dus rims nad ser ba drag po yis// 'gro ba'i lus sems phan bde'i lo thog 'joms// de phyir srung ba'i man ngag zab mo 'di// zhal gdams gab dkrugs thams cad dkyus su bkod// de la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bka' gnang stsol// dge tshogs ji snyed mar gyur 'gro la sbyin// 'di yang zur mkhar sman gling skyed tshal du// dharma swā mis gzhan la phan phyir bris// 'di la dpe'u ris kyang yod/
